items.title: Lorraine Feather interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 22, 2023
items.q: I was working at the time with Carlos Rosario, the engineer/producer who did a lot of my albums

ctx.x: Either your own lyrics or a recording?

My own lyrics not so much. I pretty well know that they’re done although what happens is that I never just sit down and hammer away until something is done. I’ll have an idea and then once I’m in the head of writing the song, the lyrics, it flows through my consciousness all the time and things come up, I’ll find little internal rhymes and rhythms, alliteration and just words that I want to use instead of other words, but once I finish it it’s pretty much done. I’m not rigid about it but singing wise I do have…
Yeah. The collaboration you did with Stephanie Trick was pretty amazing. Is there any plans for more of that?
